description: Demonstrates STT language configuration for Hindi speech recognition. The AI will understand and transcribe Hindi language from the customer.

task_messages.content: Greet the customer in Hindi: "Namaste {customer_name} ji! Main aapke order #{order_id} ke baare mein baat karne ke liye call kar rahi hoon. Kya abhi baat kar sakte hain?"

role_messages.content: You are a friendly customer service representative. The customer may speak in Hindi, and you should respond in Hindi if they do. The system is configured to understand Hindi speech.

functions.description: Call when user confirms it's a good time to talk in Hindi or English
Call when user doesn't want to continue or asks to call back later

task_messages.content: Thank the customer in Hindi: "Dhanyavaad {customer_name} ji! Aapka order confirm ho gaya hai. Aapka din shubh ho!"

role_messages.content: Thank the customer and end the call.

task_messages.content: End the call politely in Hindi: "Koi baat nahi, {customer_name} ji. Main aapko kab call karun?" Wait for their response, confirm the callback time, thank them, and end the call.

role_messages.content: Be understanding and flexible. Ask for a convenient callback time in Hindi, confirm it, then politely end the call.
